items.claim: In a 2023 interview, Singer said AI markets should be regulated and applied the same reasoning to climate change. He said cheaper but harmful practices are restricted. This is a public position in favor of regulation.
items.quote: We do regulate markets — child labour might be cheaper but that doesn't mean we allow it, we try to stop it,
items.source_title: Philosopher Peter Singer weighs in on AI, robot rights and being kinder to animals - ABC News

items.claim: In a 2025 BBC Newsnight interview, Singer named misaligned superintelligent AI as the greatest AI risk. He also said competitive investor pressure pushes AI companies to advance quickly, citing OpenAI. This is a public statement of concern about AI loss of control, not a contribution to it.
items.quote: The greatest risk is that in some way we will produce an AI that is super intelligent and that is not aligned with our values.
items.source_title: Peter Singer: "If Al is ever conscious... it should also have rights" (BBC Newsnight)
